_comment: Fill in 'repos' with the git URLs of every project that adopts the design system, then run: node src/scripts/adoption-report.js. It clones each one shallowly, reads the COMMITTED .ds/manifest.json and .ds/history.jsonl, and writes ADOPTION.md + .release/adoption.json. No telemetry, no network calls from the panel. Alternatively set 'provider' to 'github' or 'gitlab' to discover repos through an org API.
